read.en: Sandisk fell 2.6% on Nov 18 to $776.22, trading $753.86–813.18. It is below the 5-day ($841.0), 10-day ($857.1), 30-day ($1,170.9), 100-day ($1,460.9) and 200-day ($1,284.7); all but the 200-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($1,040.24), and RSI is 30.1.

No level changed: the $813.18 high was rejected above the $799–806.4 resistance, and the $753.86 low held above the Nov 17 low ($749.39). Resistance is $799–806.4 (Nov 16 low, Nov 5 low and close), then $813.2–838.5 and $841–857 (5-day, Nov 13 low, 10-day). Support is $749.4–753.9 (Nov 17 and 18 lows, $750), then $700. A close above $806.4 would target $816–838; below $749.4, $700.
